item.title: Ruben Amorim’s departure - MUST News
item.description: Ruben Amorim’s departure marks another milestone in the last decade at Manchester United which has now seen six permanent managers come and go in less than thirteen years. The patience and loyalty of United fans is legendary and has been tested constantly over that period. We thank Ruben for his efforts, and fans are left to hope the Club gets the next appointment and the structure right, and backs the new manager in the transfer market.

item.title: Appointment of Michael Carrick as interim manager - MUST News
item.description: Manchester United fans everywhere will welcome Michael Carrick’s appointment as interim manager.As a player, Michael was a fine servant of the club who wore the shirt well, with intelligence and dedication. As a coach, he impressed widely demonstrating many of those same qualities.Managing Manchester United is a difficult job. Doing so an interim basis perhaps even more so. But the fans will be loud and united behind him, starting with the derby on Saturday.
